thread:
Tariq: hey team, opening my very first change. small router tweak + one unit test. quick sanity: preferred branch name, commit format, and anything I should avoid?

Leah: welcome! branch: `feature/<TICKET>-short` or `hotfix/<TICKET>`. Keep changes minimal; if you touch public API separate into 2 PRs (api change then callers).

Tariq: cool. is there a hard PR size rule?

Leah: aim for reviews under ~400 LOC. if tests add lines, call that out in the PR body. for anything >700 LOC you should add an RFC link or a brief justification.

ci-bot: repo pre-commit hooks: black, isort, flake8, mypy. CI blocks merges on failures. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/job/1995000001

Tariq: my local lint fails. what's the easiest fixer?

Leah: run `make dev-setup` once, then `pre-commit run --all-files`. We have `scripts/format.sh` for a quick fix.

Tariq: tests: just unit? or integration as well?

Leah: unit tests are required. add a small integration test only if runtime behavior changes (networking/serialization). mock heavy deps; keep fixtures in test utils.

Tariq: reviewers? labels? approvals?

devx: add two reviewers: one CODEOWNER for the touched path + one teammate. Labels: `area/runtime`, `needs-review`. If you suspect flakiness add `flake` and ping @eng-oncall.

Tariq: commit message style?

Leah: `area(scope): short summary` e.g. `router(debounce): reduce duplicate lookups`. Put ticket ID in branch and PR title. Squash merges are default.

Tariq: any special PR body sections I should include?

Leah: yes - short description, test plan, rollback steps (1-2 lines), and any perf impact. Example rollback: "revert PR + deploy, run `tools/cachectl purge --prefix=route:`".

Tariq: generated files?

devx: don't commit generated artifacts unless the change is to the generator. Run `scripts/generate.sh` locally if you touched schema files.

ci-bot: note: tests on main had a transient DB fixture flake yesterday. If you hit it, tag `flake` and ping @eng-oncall.

eng-oncall: if CI flakes, include `--rerun-failed` in pipeline and ping me. we'll triage quickly.

Tariq: thanks all, PR incoming. I'll paste the link when it's up. :grinning:

Leah: excited to review! drop the PR here and we can do a quick pair if you want. :thumbsup:
